# group: # One line per logical package. "-" means "not packaged / not needed on this distro".
# Names that turn out to be unavailable at install time are skipped with a warning,
# and the fallbacks in lib/extras.sh fill the gaps for a few important tools.
# ---- core: everything a working desktop session needs, regardless of X11/Wayland
# pactl: volume keys and the volume popup (tux-osd), tux-audio, tux-capture

arch: thunar thunar-archive-plugin thunar-volman tumbler exo xarchiver
debian: thunar thunar-archive-plugin thunar-volman tumbler exo-utils xarchiver
void: Thunar thunar-archive-plugin thunar-volman tumbler exo xarchiver

arch: xorg-server xorg-xinit xorg-xrandr xorg-xset xorg-xinput xorg-xprop xorg-xrdb xorg-xkill xorg-xsetroot
void: xorg-minimal xinit xrandr xset xinput xprop xrdb xkill xsetroot

# group: # rofi draws the workspace overview grid (native Wayland since rofi 2.0, XWayland before)
# Neovim = LazyVim (VS Code-like). Debian 13 ships 0.10 / tree-sitter 0.22: too old, so upstream releases.
# Node runs most language servers (Python, TypeScript, JSON, YAML, Docker) that LazyVim installs on use.
# rmpc: mpd client with album art (kitty graphics) and a cava visualizer pane. Debian: upstream release.

debian: nodejs npm python3-pip golang rustc cargo
